    Correct the four remaining P3B root causes in one aggregate round
    
    Root adjudication: reports/v0-s3/product-gate0/p3b-correction-03.adjudication.json
    (CHANGES_REQUIRED_FOUR_LOCAL_ROOT_CAUSES; 0 fatal, 4 major).  The
    correction-02 independent review 12906163857a34bfc9afa8fa52a66dfa6fae296a
    is the authoritative trigger.  The findings it closed stay closed and all of
    their obligations are retained.  No public API, quality threshold,
    denominator, authorization or contract changed.
    
    M01  The terminal receipt is now durable before it is authoritative.  The
         bounded canonical payload is written to an exclusive staged file under
         the pinned descriptor parent, flushed and fsynced there, and only a
         successful durable staging is published under the canonical name with a
         no-overwrite hard link between the pinned handles.  There is no
         rename-overwrite and no absolute-path fallback.  While the staging is
         unpublished, no canonical receipt exists, so no consumer can read it as
         a terminal receipt; the staged bytes are explicitly non-authoritative
         and the canonical loader rejects them.  A failed write, flush or fsync
         at the staging descriptor leaves no canonical success, returns a
         blocked receipt with an unknown storage state, and preserves the failed
         staging as retained non-authoritative evidence that a replay cannot
         overwrite.  The honest accounting counts both retained entries and
         their bytes, the frozen 8MiB/128MiB/256 caps stay exact, and the
         receipt states that a file fsync and a successful publication do not
         prove the crash durability of the parent directory entry.
    
    M08  The source, storage and cleanup evidence now has complete typed shared
         validators that the execution phase and the scoring entry point both
         use.  The source evidence carries the full typed descriptor identity,
         the positive bounded size and hash and a source path bound to the run
         root and the input reference; the release evidence carries the actual
         bounded release proof with the strict integer empty model inventory,
         the actual 3..32 native sample dictionaries, the finite non-boolean
         elapsed time, the bound baseline, the monotone cadence and the last
         three samples at the baseline.  The execution phase emits the receipt
         and per row storage_unproven and cleanup_unproven booleans explicitly
         and the scoring entry point requires the literal False; absent, null or
         wrong typed declarations are unknown and never default to a pass.  Only
         a published canonical receipt is authority at the consumer boundary.
    
    NM01 and NM02  One final local send-admission guard now runs after every
         controlled preparation, authorization and source callback and directly
         before the local reservation, the attempt charge and the submit, with
         no unchecked callback in between.  It revalidates the original
         ownership, the finite non-boolean non-decreasing clock and the phase
         deadline, and the exact typed parent proof with its validity interval
         and the current sufficient remaining capacity; the cumulative local
         reservation never exceeds the admitted capacity or 34, and there is no
         refund and no retry.  A proof that expires or is diminished at the send
         boundary, or a callback that returns past the phase deadline, produces
         zero sends and all sixteen rows refused, while a later refusal keeps
         the earlier attempts and their charges.  The cooperative guard is not a
         preemption of a synchronous callback; the mandatory parent watchdog
         stays UNIMPLEMENTED_PRODUCT_GATE0_BLOCKER.
    
    The original 112 checks are preserved; 33 focused regressions were added,
    145 in total.  Every check was executed through the guarded runner with the
    audit hook installed before pytest and before any product import.
